Dear students,

Sorry for the slight confusion. Your first BPT release is available on the course VM. You can access it through your course VM.

There are four questions you can see:

  1. /opt/se2001/BPT1_problem_1
  2. /opt/se2001/BPT1_problem_2
  3. /opt/se2001/BPT1_problem_3
  4. /opt/se2001/BPT1_problem_4

I am attaching a screenshot for your reference:

This will be the final release for BPT1. We are extending the deadline until 12th October. Since this is your first BPT, please ensure you solve all the questions before 12th October.

posts.cooked:

posts.name: Puneet
posts.cooked:
Hi,

Can’t tell you the answer I guess. But two key points -

  1. ln -s command has to be used for creating soft links.
  2. You have to use absolute path and not the relative path in this question.

Follow this and you will be able to solve this question easily.

Regards,
Puneet

posts.cooked:

accepted_answer.excerpt:
Yes you can run synchro eval to confirm and resubmit the assignments.

However the BPTs may or may not be different from last term, so look into those as and when they’re released
